name: @duducks/circuits
description: Zero Knowledge Proof circuits for DuDucks government document verification

scripts.ptau: snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 12 build/aadhaar_0000.ptau -v && snarkjs powersoftau contribute build/aadhaar_0000.ptau build/aadhaar_1000.ptau --name='First' -v && snarkjs powersoftau prepare-phase2 build/aadhaar_1000.ptau build/aadhaar_final.ptau -v
scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/aadhaar.r1cs build/aadhaar_final.ptau build/aadhaar_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute build/aadhaar_0000.zkey build/aadhaar_final.zkey --name='Groth16 setup' -v && snarkjs zkey verify build/aadhaar.r1cs build/aadhaar_final.ptau build/aadhaar_final.zkey
scripts.vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/aadhaar_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.prove: snarkjs groth16 prove build/aadhaar_final.zkey witness.wtns proof.json public.json
scripts.verify: snarkjs groth16 verify build/verification_key.json public.json proof.json
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run setup && npm run vkey

author: DuDucks Team
